meta.title: CET-4 Workbench
meta.description: An unofficial CET-4 study panel: core and syllabus vocabulary drilled unit by unit, past-paper listening with per-set audio playback, random practice for banked cloze, paragraph matching and reading comprehension, part or full translation, essay writing, plus wordbook and mistake book. Everything is scored offline; answers are provided without explanations. Papers and audio are supplied by the user.
